title: Ferro-Prussic
summary: FERRO-PRUS'SIC, adjective [Latin ferrum, iron, and prussic.] Designating a peculiar acid, formed of prussic acid and protoxyd of iron.

inlines.v: FERRO-PRUS'SIC, adjective [Latin ferrum, iron, and prussic.] Designating a peculiar acid, formed of prussic acid and protoxyd of iron.
